description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'ProductStoreWorker' responsible for handling store-related functionalities within the Apache OFBiz e-commerce framework. It includes methods for retrieving product store entities, managing shipping and payment settings, handling surveys, and inventory checks, among others.

classes.name: ProductStoreWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing product store related operations, including retrieving store info, payment and shipment settings, surveys, and inventory checks.

methods.name: getProductStore
methods.description: Retrieve ProductStore entity by ID using delegator.

methods.name: getProductStore
methods.description: Retrieve ProductStore entity based on the current request, considering session and website context.

methods.name: getProductStoreId
methods.description: Extract the product store ID from the HTTP session or website context.

methods.name: getStoreCurrencyUomId
methods.description: Get the default currency Unit of Measure ID for the current store.

methods.name: getStoreLocale
methods.description: Get the locale for the current store.

methods.name: getStoreTimeZone
methods.description: Get the timezone for the current store.

methods.name: determineSingleFacilityForStore
methods.description: Determine if the store has a single inventory facility based on its settings.

methods.name: autoSaveCart
methods.description: Check if the store is configured to autosave carts.

methods.name: getProductStorePayToPartyId
methods.description: Retrieve the 'pay to' party ID for a store.

methods.name: getProductStorePaymentProperties
methods.description: Get payment properties path for a store, filtered by payment method and service type.

methods.name: getProductStorePaymentSetting
methods.description: Retrieve payment setting GenericValue for a store based on criteria.

methods.name: getProductStoreShipmentMethods
methods.description: Retrieve shipment methods for a store with specified criteria.

methods.name: getProductStoreShipmentMethod
methods.description: Retrieve first matching shipment method for a store.

methods.name: getAvailableStoreShippingMethods
methods.description: Determine available shipping methods given address, item sizes, features, geos, etc.

methods.name: getRandomSurveyWrapper
methods.description: Select a random survey wrapper for the current store, optionally within a group.

methods.name: getProductSurveys
methods.description: Retrieve surveys associated with a product in a store.

methods.name: getSurveys
methods.description: Filter and retrieve a list of surveys based on various criteria and product association.

methods.name: checkSurveyResponse
methods.description: Count responses for a survey by current user session.

methods.name: checkSurveyResponse
methods.description: Count responses for a survey by party ID and store.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryRequired
methods.description: Determine if store inventory is required for a product.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryAvailable
methods.description: Check if store inventory is available for a product and quantity.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryRequiredAndAvailable
methods.description: Check if inventory is both required and available for a product, with optional quantity and flags.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryAvailable (with ProductConfigWrapper)
methods.description: Check inventory availability for a product with configuration, delegator, and dispatcher context.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryAvailable
methods.description: Check inventory at specific product store and facilities, considering inventory checks configuration.
